pub trait AuthorizationOperator
  type Error
  fn observe_policy(&self, after: ::std::string::String, wait_ms: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyObservation, Self::Error>
  fn register_described_action(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, description: ActionDescription) -> ::std::result::Result<DescriptionEdit, Self::Error>
  fn apply_first_use_allow(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, question_id: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn list_policy(&self, cursor: ::std::string::String, limit: i64) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyPage, Self::Error>
  fn set_rule(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, rule: PolicyRule) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn revoke_rule(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, subject: Subject, action: ::std::string::String, resource: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn stop_answerer(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, answerer: Subject, also_revoke_grants: bool) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn revoke_answer_permits(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, answerer: Subject, target: Subject, actions: ::std::vec::Vec<::std::string::String>, resource: ::std::string::String, question_id: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn set_rule_for(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, rule: PolicyRule, ttl_ms: i64, why: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn set_rules_for(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, rules: ::std::vec::Vec<PolicyRule>, ttl_ms: i64, why: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<PolicyEdit, Self::Error>
  fn read_rule(&self, subject: Subject, action: ::std::string::String, resource: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<RuleRead, Self::Error>
  fn register_action(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, action: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<ActionEdit, Self::Error>
  fn retire_action(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, action: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<ActionEdit, Self::Error>
  fn explain_for(&self, subject: Subject, action: ::std::string::String, resource: ::std::string::String) -> ::std::result::Result<DecisionExplanation, Self::Error>
  fn list_defaults(&self) -> ::std::result::Result<DefaultPage, Self::Error>
  fn set_default(&self, expected_revision: ::std::string::String, name: ::std::string::String, on: bool) -> ::std::result::Result<DefaultEdit, Self::Error>
